dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, were you good at sports when you were a child?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, wɜːr juː ˈɡʊd ət ˈspɔːrts wɛn juː wɜːr ə ˈtʃaɪld?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! I could run fast, and I could climb trees.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! aɪ kʊd ˈrʌn ˈfæst, ənd aɪ kʊd ˈklaɪm ˈtriːz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, I couldn't. I learned when I was twelve.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪ ˈkʊdənt. aɪ ˈlɜːrnd wɛn aɪ wʌz ˈtwɛlv.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: When I was a child, I could kick a ball very hard.
dialogue.reading: wɛn aɪ wʌz ə ˈtʃaɪld, aɪ kʊd ˈkɪk ə ˈbɔːl ˈvɛri ˈhɑːrd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Could you throw a ball far, too?
dialogue.reading: kʊd juː ˈθroʊ ə ˈbɔːl ˈfɑːr, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, and I could jump very high. But now my knees hurt!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ənd aɪ kʊd ˈdʒʌmp ˈvɛri ˈhaɪ. bʌt ˈnaʊ maɪ ˈniːz ˈhɜːrt!
